deadline.value: International PhD applicants: priority deadline December 15 (considered for funding), final deadline January 15. Fall entry only.

also.quote: PhD applicants are encouraged to submit their applications by the priority deadline to be considered for funding

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of international PhD fee waivers are offered to qualified individuals by request.
fee_waiver.quote: We also offer a limited number of international applicant fee waivers for the PhD program for qualified individuals.

gre_general.value: GRE is no longer required; submitting a score is encouraged if available.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required for PhD or MS admissions to the Department of Chemical Engineering.

gre_subject.value: The department does not mention a subject test.

supervisor.value: The department does not say whether a supervisor is needed before applying.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are employed as Graduate Fellows or Research Assistants with a stipend over USD 34,000 a year and a tuition benefit.
funding.quote: All PhD graduate students admitted to the chemical engineering graduate program are employed as either Graduate Fellows or Graduate Research Assistants

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the entry requirement; the department admits recent bachelor's graduates to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a Bachelors degree from a regionally accredited college or university.

notes: English test exemption in the department text covers only degrees from the US, Canada (except Quebec), UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand; India is not listed.
